Cindy Carlson Realty
KELLOGG, ID
Welcome To Cindy Carlson Realty
Cindy Carlson Realty A Full Service Real Estate Agency located in Kellogg Idaho.
View listings
THE AREA
North Idaho’s Silver Valley
Nestled in the foothills of the Rocky Mountains, in the heart of the Panhandle National Forest, the Silver Valley is most noted for its mining heritage, dating back to the 1880s. The Silver Valley is also famous for it’s Ski Resorts ~ Silver Mountain and Lookout Pass; it’s Bike Trails, ATV Trails and The World’s Longest Gondola. The narrow valley, about 40 miles in length, comprises a number of small towns along the South Fork of the Coeur d’Alene River and Interstate 90.
ABOUT
Cindy Carlson, Broker, Realtor ® , ABR, CRS, GRI, RSPS, RPAC Major Investor
Cindy Carlson, Broker/owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, located in Kellogg, Idaho, is a 18 year residential/commercial real estate veteran. With deep roots to this area, Cindy and her husband Denny, have raised their family and enjoyed this scenic area for over 40 years. After 25+ years as a well known figure at a local dentist office, she decided to take her personal skills and stellar work ethic and turn it into a real estate career.

YOUR INTRODUCTION
As the broker and owner of Cindy Carlson Realty, I bring over 18 years of real estate insight combined with a lifelong passion for helping others thrive in North Idaho. My approach has always been founded on integrity, constant learning, and genuine care for this community. Having raised my family here and served on local boards, I value giving back and believe in leading the market through knowledge and service. My team and I are proud to serve buyers and sellers across the Silver Valley, offering attentive guidance and seasoned advice at every step.
